name: ponytail
tagline_zh: 懒得写代码？让马尾辫替你干活：只做你要的，不搞抽象，不堆依赖，用标准库搞定一切。写、改、修、审，一条龙偷懒。
tagline_en: Lazy senior dev mode: do exactly what you ask, no abstractions, stdlib first. Write, refactor, fix, review—all in.
desc_en: Lazy senior dev mode for any coding task (write, refactor, fix, review): YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions. Not for non-coding requests.
why_zh: 同类工具爱炫技，它却坚持YAGNI和标准库优先，砍掉所有多余抽象，像老手一样只写必要代码。
why_en: Unlike AI that over-engineers, it enforces YAGNI and stdlib-first, cutting all unrequested abstractions—just the code you need.
